correctness.rationale: The helper implements the inspectable scaffolding: PR arg validation, INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT defaults, allow-list loading with [bot] stripping, GraphQL snapshot parsing, head SHA comparison across iterations, pre-sleep head re-check, and RESULT=/HEAD= emission on CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, and API_ERROR with documented exit codes. Participating allow-listed bots must have latest review commit matching head before CONVERGED when bots are present. Material gaps remain: with zero participating allow-listed bots and zero unresolved bot threads the terminal flag stays true and the script exits CONVERGED immediately, which is unsafe for a settle-window helper; the quiet-window timestamp uses jq max over all reviews and thread comments without filtering to allow-listed bot authors, so human or non-allowlisted activity can skew QUIET_ELAPSED; and reviewThreads/reviews are capped at last:100 with no pagination.

quality.rationale: Implementation is readable and repo-shaped: focused five-file diff, canonical allow-list file, shell helper with set -e, prompt update preferring the helper while preserving the documented sleep 360 fallback, and AI_REPO_GUIDE inventory/table entries. Deductions for inline requirement-tracing comments in the poll loop, nested O(n*m) allow-list matching loops, and ~180 lines of inline GraphQL/jq logic without extracted lib helpers or README coverage beyond the guide table.

Required doc companions are synced and the prompt keeps the time-based fallback. latest_event jq max aggregates all review submittedAt and all thread comment createdAt without allow-list filtering before QUIET_ELAPSED comparison.

TIMEOUT exits 2 with RESULT=TIMEOUT HEAD=${head_sha:-unknown}; API_ERROR exits 4 for missing PR, missing allow-list, or gh/graphql failures.
